menu.title: BASE DESTROYER
menu.welcome:
Welcome, Commander! 🚀

Defend the Base from alien invaders.
Collect diamonds and upgrade your ship.

instructions.title: 📖 HOW TO PLAY
instructions.body:
🎮 CONTROLS
← → or A/D - Move left/right
↑ ↓ or W/S - Move up/down
SPACE - Auto-shoot
ESC - Pause game

🎯 OBJECTIVE
-  Destroy enemies and bases
-  Collect diamonds 💎
-  Pick up power-ups ⚡
-  Upgrade your ship in shop
-  Complete missions and defeat bosses

👾 ENEMIES
🔴 Red spheres - Weak (fast)
🔷 Hexagons - Medium (shows HP)
🟦 Blue cubes - BASES (destroy these!)

🛒 SHOP
-  Buy new spaceships
-  Upgrade weapons
-  Improve stats
-  Increase fire rate & damage

Good luck, Commander! 🚀
